## Graph.\_types property

never set: carries the entities, the runs' ctx and the routes in the type. The ctx and the  routes are a function's parameter and result, so that a graph is one of its own `Ctx` and  routes only: one whose loads read `{ a, b }` is not a graph of `{ a }`<!-- -->, whose runs would give  them half of it, and one of some routes is not one of more. `GraphDef<Meta>` is the graph  with its types forgotten

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly _types?: {
        readonly entities: E;
        readonly ctx: (ctx: Ctx) => Ctx;
        readonly routes: (routes: R) => R;
    };
```
